papers.title_en: PRISM: Precision Forcing for Generalist Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.authors: Chenghao Yue, Peiyan Li, Hao Wang, Lei Lv, Jiahao Chen, Huaping Liu, Yu Luo, Yuanlong Zhang
papers.evidence: 用于生成式策略学习的流匹配动作专家
papers.tldr: 现有VLM与流匹配动作专家结合的VLA策略在亚毫米级精密操作中仍不可靠，根源是监督在上下文与流时间上分配失衡，关键决策时刻监督不足。PRISM离线评分精度需求，在误差后果大且动作信号可见处增强流监督，并把需求内化到VLM条件表征。仿真与真机在连接器插接、双臂对接和螺丝拧紧任务上，将平均端到端成功率从38.3%提升至86.7%。该方法无需新传感器或观测模态，在保持通用任务性能的同时拓展了具身策略的精度边界。
papers.abstract_en: Coupling a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) with a diffusion or flow-matching action expert has become the mainstream vision-language-action (VLA) paradigm for embodied policies, yet they remain unreliable once a task demands precise manipulation, e.g., submillimeter cable insertion. We attribute this weakness to a training objective that averages flow-matching errors across contexts and flow times, allocating little supervision to the few decisive moments determining task success. Along the generative path, inference integrates a locally supervised velocity field, so equally penalized errors at different flow times can affect the executed action unequally. Consequently, precision-task performance deteriorates as physical tolerance tightens by orders of magnitude. We call this supervision imbalance across contexts and flow times Flow-Time Starvation. The remedy is to jointly align supervision allocation and representation learning with context-dependent precision demand, enabling the policy to recognize when greater precision is needed. We instantiate this precision-forcing strategy as Precision-aware Reweighting and Internalization for Skilled Manipulation (PRISM), which scores precision demand offline, strengthens flow supervision where errors are consequential and action signals are visible, and internalizes that demand in the VLM condition representation. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that PRISM preserves or improves general-task performance while raising mean end-to-end success from 38.3% to 86.7% across drive connector insertion, bimanual connector mating, and screw tightening, substantially extending the precision boundary of existing embodied policies without new sensors or observation modalities.

papers.title_en: Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Thanh Nguyen, Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany, Hwanhee Kim, Chang D. Yoo
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配的单步生成式策略用于离线强化学习
papers.tldr: 扩散策略在离线强化学习中表达力强，但多步去噪带来高昂计算开销，并需训练时进行 BPTT。InsQL 以流匹配视角建模平均速度并引入组合机制，实现从噪声到动作的单步映射。在标准离线 RL 基准和真实机器人操作任务上，它匹配或超越先进扩散方法，同时显著降低训练与推理时间。该工作为高效可扩展的离线 RL 生成式策略提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising introduces substantial computational overhead and requires backpropagation through time during training, limiting scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we propose \textbf{Instant Flow Q-Learning (InsQL)}, a single-step generative policy learning framework that retains the expressive capacity of diffusion models while eliminating iterative sampling and BPTT. InsQL builds on the flow-matching perspective of diffusion policies, but replaces marginal velocity parameterization with \emph{average-velocity} modeling and introduces a principled compositional mechanism, yielding a theoretically grounded objective that learns average velocity consistently across scales. This formulation provides a direct noise-to-action mapping and enables single-step action generation. InsQL further unifies compositional average-velocity modeling with behavior-regularized actor--critic optimization in a single framework, requiring only a single policy network and avoiding distillation, multi-stage procedures, and Jacobian computations during training. At inference time, actions are generated in a single forward pass and can be refined via value-guided candidate selection to improve performance. Extensive experiments on standard offline RL benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that InsQL matches or surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods while substantially reducing both training and inference time. Overall, these results establish compositional average-velocity modeling as an efficient and scalable alternative to multi-step generative policies for offline RL.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: Mode- and Support-Aware Inference-Time Control of Robot Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Sabrina Bodmer, Rahel Rickenbach, René Zurbrügg, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Colin Jones
papers.evidence: 面向机器人行为的扩散模型
papers.tldr: 扩散策略等生成式机器人策略虽有强表达能力，但部署时常遇到训练数据未覆盖的新约束与目标。MOSAIC 提出模式与支撑感知的无梯度推理时控制框架，把初始噪声与反向去噪扰动视为联合输入，用全去噪输出的重要性权重自适应更新其分布，并以自适应惩罚平衡物理可行性与学到的支撑。在导航、灵巧抓取、未知几何运动规划及多机器人协作搬运中，MOSAIC 无需重训练即可适配并组合冻结的扩散先验。
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies such as diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for robot behavior, yet the situations a robot faces at execution time rarely match its training data and impose constraints and objectives the policy never learned. Existing inference-time guidance methods either rely on gradients that can push samples away from the learned prior, or on sampling procedures that can be inefficient, collapse modes, or average them into out-of-distribution predictions.   We introduce MOSAIC, a mode- and support-aware framework for gradient-free inference-time control of robotic diffusion models. MOSAIC treats the initial noise and all stochastic reverse-step perturbations as a joint input to the pretrained denoising process and adapts a distribution over this input using importance weights computed from fully denoised outputs. Physical feasibility and consistency with the learned support are balanced using adaptive penalties, while mode-wise importance-weighted updates preserve modes and avoid destructive averaging.   The same formulation can jointly steer multiple independently trained diffusion models through shared coupling costs, enabling coordinated behavior without requiring a joint model. We evaluate MOSAIC on navigation, dexterous grasping, motion planning with unseen geometry, and collaborative box manipulation with independently trained robot priors. Across these settings, MOSAIC adapts and composes frozen diffusion priors under new deployment constraints without retraining.

papers.title_en: Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast
papers.authors: Jiajing Hu, Xu Han, Li-Ping Liu
papers.evidence: 用于概率时间序列预测的统一流匹配建模
papers.tldr: 时间序列概率预测需准确量化不确定性，但现有确定性预测与生成模型联合训练常不稳定，因确定性模型嵌入生成过程导致计算图深、概率传输路径变化。DV-Flow提出统一流匹配框架，将确定性预测器作为并行速度分量而非传输终点，实现稳定端到端优化。在六个真实数据集上，该方法持续优于强基线，并能统一比较多种现有形式。其贡献在于提供更稳定、可比较的概率预测建模范式。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for many time series forecasting applications, and recent studies have increasingly adopted generative models to capture predictive uncertainty. Existing approaches often combine deterministic forecasting with generative modeling to improve predictive performance. However, their joint training is typically unstable because the deterministic model is embedded within the generative process, resulting in deep computational graphs and changing the probability transport path. In this work, we propose DV-Flow, a unified flow-matching formulation that incorporates the deterministic predictor as a parallel velocity component rather than as the endpoint of the transport path. This design enables stable end-to-end optimization while subsuming several existing formulations as special cases, allowing direct comparisons among them. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that DV-Flow consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance over strong baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/tufts-ml/dv-flow-time-series.

papers.title_en: ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow
papers.authors: Jing Xu, Zenglin Xu, Li Yi, Ruoxi Jiang, Yuan Qi
papers.evidence: 用条件流匹配建模 PDE 代理残差分布
papers.tldr: 神经PDE代理经MSE训练易丢失高频细节，而生成模型在自回归推演中会累积随机误差、损害长期稳定性。ReAl作为模型无关插件，先以条件流匹配学习确定性基预测周围的残差分布，再通过多轨迹奖励强化修正器实现动力学对齐。实验表明其在多种代理架构与PDE任务上持续提升高频保真、预测精度与长期稳定性。该工作为预训练神经算子提供通用细化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Neural partial differential equation (PDE) surrogates trained with mean squared error (MSE) can capture dominant dynamics but often lose high-frequency information and fine-scale structures. Generative models (e.g., Flow Matching) can capture the distribution of fine-scale details, yet stochastic errors may accumulate during autoregressive rollouts and compromise long-term stability. To address these limitations, we introduce Refine and Align(ReAl), a model-agnostic plug-in that augments pretrained PDE surrogates to improve the reconstruction of high-frequency structures associated with complex physical phenomena. In the refinement stage, a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the deterministic base prediction, recovering missing fine-scale structures while retaining the dominant dynamics. In the alignment stage, to mitigate the generative discrepancies amplified in the autoregressive rollout, particularly in chaotic systems, we generate multiple trajectories from the same input and reinforce the refiner with trajectory-level rewards, thereby achieving long-horizon dynamical alignment. Experiments across diverse surrogate architectures and PDE tasks demonstrate that ReAl consistently improves high-frequency fidelity, forecasting accuracy, and long-horizon stability.

papers.title_en: On the Stability and Convergence of Flow Map Training
papers.authors: Ishan Nath, Tom Stanic, Avishek Joey Bose, Gauthier Gidel, Quentin Bertrand
papers.evidence: 基于流映射训练的概率生成
papers.tldr: Flow map 将扩散轨迹摊销为一步采样器，但停止梯度和自适应加权为何有效仍缺乏理论解释。本文分析 MeanFlow 与 Lagrangian 损失诱导的函数梯度流，证明其可收敛到真实流映射。有限更新下可能出现无界更新，自适应归一化可给出有界更新并在特定加权下收敛到解邻域。合成与图像实验验证理论并表明合适重加权强度对性能关键。
papers.abstract_en: Flow maps are a recent method of probabilistic generation that amortize diffusion trajectories into one-step samplers, unlocking efficient generation. While progress has been made in improving their empirical performance, there is still a lack of understanding behind the mechanisms underlying their success. Specifically, many flow map learning methods employ stop gradient operators as a crucial part of their training target. Adaptive weighting also drastically improves the generation capabilities of flow maps. Although many interpretations have been proposed to support the inclusion of these heuristics, none have analyzed the impact of these assumptions on the training dynamics of flow maps themselves. In this work, we address this issue by providing grounded theory explaining why such tricks are required. Analyzing the functional gradient flow induced by the MeanFlow and Lagrangian losses, we show their convergence to the true flow map, settling the validity of these objectives. For finite updates, we highlight a severe roadblock to the usage of these losses in practice: the possible unboundedness of the update. Adaptive normalization not only provides bounded updates, but, combined with a specific weighting, additionally provides convergence guarantees towards a neighborhood of the solution. On synthetic data, we show that our functional gradient flow analysis exactly describes the true training dynamics for flow maps. Experiments on standard image datasets demonstrate that a proper reweighting scheme is essential for strong empirical performance, which is only achieved for a specific range of reweighting strengths.

papers.title_en: FocusOPD: Structure-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Xinrui Lin, Shumin Wang, Suqi Song, Fan Li, Yanyong Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向整流流扩散Transformer的在线策略蒸馏与特征对齐
papers.tldr: 多教师在线策略蒸馏能让 rectified-flow 扩散模型的学生模型融合多种任务能力，但仅匹配输出并不能保证内部特征对齐。作者分析 Transformer 各块与去噪时间步的特征错配，发现错配集中在深层块和早期去噪阶段，且蒸馏后仍存在。为此提出 FocusOPD，在深层与早期步上加入 token 级方向特征对齐。主基准上 GenEval 从 0.953 升至 0.967，PickScore 与 LAION-Aesthetic 亦有提升，消融表明选择性监督更高效。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation enables rectified-flow models with diffusion-transformer architectures to combine task-specific capabilities within a single student. However, matching model outputs does not guarantee that their internal representations are aligned, and it remains unclear where and when additional feature supervision is most useful. We analyze the teacher-student feature mismatch across Transformer blocks and denoising timesteps, and find that the mismatch is concentrated in deeper Transformer blocks during early denoising and persists after OPD distillation, indicating ineffective distillation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce FocusOPD, which augments the base OPD objective with token-wise directional feature alignment restricted to deep layers and early denoising steps. Across two rectified-flow backbones and multiple OPD objectives, FocusOPD improves capability transfer in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference-based evaluation. On the primary benchmark, it improves over DiffusionOPD from 0.953 to 0.967 on GenEval, from 23.797 to 23.944 on PickScore, and from 6.052 to 6.199 on LAION-Aesthetic. Ablations show that selective deep and early supervision is more effective and efficient than alignment over the full network and trajectory.

papers.title_en: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Zirui Wu, Chen Guo, Tianjian Jiang, Zeren Jiang, Zeming Li, Lingchen Yang, Longteng Duan, Ying Xue, Handi Yin, Shenyuan Gao, Martin R. Oswald, Jun Zhang, Ping Tan, Jie Song
papers.evidence: 视频扩散Transformer联合生成三维动作轨迹与视觉未来
papers.tldr: 针对自我中心灵巧操作中感知、预测与规划割裂的问题，P3-WAM将3D手部重建、动作条件视频预测和目标导向规划统一到世界动作模型中。模型以共享权重的混合Transformer把结构化3D动作接入视频扩散Transformer，并通过随机模态可见性实现双向视觉-动作建模。实验表明统一训练提升三种能力，在四个数据集上优于专用基线，并生成指令遵循和动作进展更好的操作视频。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
